title: Tankers Hit Near Hormuz as Iran Says It Controls the Strait: What It Means for Oil and India
description_html:
Two tankers were reported hit by unidentified projectiles near Khasab on Oman's northern coast, Iran says it controls the strait, and the fighting has reached Bahrain again. We explain what the UK Maritime Trade Operations centre reported, what Iran and Bahrain say, why diplomacy has not caught up, and what it means for fuel prices, the Gulf and the millions of Indians who work there. Claims by Iran are as reported and not verified by us. This is the second main story from our Daily Crux of 23 November.

Sources: UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO), Al Jazeera, Iranian armed forces statements as reported, and Bahrain's government. Claims labelled as reported or alleged are not verified by us.
